ns2:section.sectionText: This section meets online. Students who register in this section will not be charged an Art + Design Facilities Fee and will not be granted access to the Art + Design Facilities for this course. This course is intended for first-year students in the School of Art+Design.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or Painting or Sculpture or Art Education or Art Undeclared or New Media or Studio Art or Art and Art History major(s) or minor(s).
